description: Schéma cyclable - Saint-Lô Agglo - Schéma d'intention au 1er janvier 2019 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. Outline of the current cycle plan for Saint-Lô Agglo (from the Study for the development of a cycle plan for Saint-Lô Agglo, Transport Technology - Consult Karlsruhe GmbH, December 2018). Collection context Cycling diagram in force on Saint-Lô Agglo, developed in 2019. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling diagram - Saint-Lô Agglo - Intention diagram as of January 1, 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. Its keywords include schema-cyclable, schema-dintention, saint-lo-agglo, ttk, transport, 2019. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
